purpose: Explain a treatment; teach 緩和/ニーズ/入院/制御/失っ/ショック/表面/確信

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 緩和ケアって、どんな治療ですか？
lines.en: What kind of treatment is palliative care?
lines.style: curious interviewer asking, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 痛みを和らげ、患者のニーズを優先します。
lines.en: We ease pain and prioritize patient needs.
lines.style: doctor explaining the philosophy, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 入院が必要な場合もありますか？
lines.style: interviewer probing, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ。容体を制御しながら見守ります。
lines.en: Yes. We watch over them while controlling the condition.
lines.style: doctor detailing the approach, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 意識を失っても、対応できるんですか？
lines.en: Can you handle it if they lose consciousness?
lines.style: interviewer asking carefully, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 急変はショックですが、備えています。
lines.en: Sudden changes are a shock, but we’re prepared.
lines.style: doctor conveying readiness, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 皮膚の表面のケアも大事なんですね。
lines.style: interviewer noting a detail, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: そうです。私たちは、治療に確信を持って臨みます。
lines.en: Yes. We approach treatment with conviction.
lines.style: doctor closing resolutely, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
